notes.title: The Secret of Gillwood 2.0.
notes.content:
The biggest patch yet for the game is here! A lot of updates have been made to the world and the UI to bring a better user experience and a better flow through the whole game.  


[list]
[*] The main character has been changed to make it easier to see where you are standing and for better visuals. 
[*] The orbs to pick up have been reworked and are now easier to spot in the world. 
[*] All Menus in the game have been updated with new pictures and a cleaner Ui. 
[*] The intro video has been reworked with less text to read.
[*] Skip Intro button have been added for players that want to skip the cinematic.  
[*] Fixed a bug that made all the settings go down to 0 on Quick Loaded. 
[*] Rebuild the starting area to easier introduce the player to the game mechanics.  
[*] There is now tutorial text in the start area for new players to learn how to play. 
[*] Cleaned up parts of the world to make the game more linear and to improve the overall game flow. 
[*] Removed the Light House explorable area, the light house is now on the other side of the water away from the players.
[*] Removed Light House achievement.  
[*] The first puzzle has been reworked to make it easier for the players to find where to go and progress future into the game.   
[*] The second puzzle has been reworked a little to give the players more choices and make it easier getting started.
[*] The fourth puzzle have had some small tweaks because players could get stuck behind barrels. 
[*] The fifth puzzle now has a pole in the middle for the players to save on.
[*] Fixed some flying trees, rocks and grasses in the world.  
[*] Increased the overall light in the world to make it easier to see in the game. 
[*] All lamps have been updated to enhance the world. 
[*] End cinematic have been updated to make it shorter and easier to read. 
[*] Locked gates are now easier to see in the world. 
[*] New game logotype 
[*] The store page has been updated with new art, trailer and information. 
[/list]

We hope you enjoy this new patch as much as we did develop it![url=[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34661954/f119287ae4771b00a1acd1600602edc981e0f305.png[/img]

notes.title: New Artwork and Patch!
notes.content:
Hi!

The Secret of Gillwood is getting a big update this week that will improve a lot for the players!
We start the week with a new logotype and artwork, later this week there will come updates to the game. Updated Level Design, updated platforms, Ui, Menus and much more!

Kind Regards
Snow Moose Entertainment

notes.title: Patch 1.1 "Gameplay Improvements" 2019-04-01
notes.content:
[b] Patch 1.1 contains the following changes and updates![/b]

[list]
[*] Added more light sources to the starting area  
[*]Quick Save Cooldown has been reduced by 50% from 15 sec to 7.5 sec
[*] The Intro Cinematic has been updated and now shows Features in the game!
Quick Save, Quick Load, Sprint and Sneak. 
[*] Fixed spelling errors and reduced the length of the intro
[*] End Cinematic spelling errors and better text have been implemented and Credits video is now shorter
[*] Bug fix!
Game Icon now shows the real Game Icon and not Unreal Engine Icon


[/list]
